details.title: Programming in Scala
details.author: Martin Odersky, Lex Spoon, Bill Venners

reading.review:
The definitive guide to Scala, written by the language's creator and collaborators. Rather than just listing syntax, it patiently explains why functional and object-oriented constructs fit together cleanly.

  • Clear progression from immutable collections to pattern matching and type classes
  • Practical refactoring examples that encourage concise, readable code

note.note-text: Case classes and sealed traits make modeling algebraic data types remarkably expressive and compiler-checked.
Preferring immutable collections by default eliminates an entire class of subtle shared-state bugs.
